name: map_slice
purpose: Judge whether a 16-beat stretch of a Beat Saber difficulty is awkward to play (map_eval, advisory).

fields.name: notes
fields.meaning: The notes of one 16-beat stretch, one per line: beat, hand (L or R), column x0-x3, row y0-y2, cut direction.

fields.name: tempo
fields.meaning: The song's tempo in beats per minute and this stretch's notes per second.

ask.instructions: At `tempo`, would a player find the swings in `notes` awkward?
ask.yes: a hand must reverse or cross its own path with no time, reach across the whole grid between close notes, or two notes block each other
ask.no: each hand alternates forehand and backhand swings with room to move between notes

gate.why: measured 2026-09-27, scripts/calibrate-specs.mjs on ranked maps from a private seed corpus and broken fixtures: 20 good vs 20 bad (16-beat stretches of ranked Expert+ maps vs random and all-down versions); AUC 0.578; at 5% false rejects 45% caught: gating needs AUC >= 0.85 and at least 50% caught at 5% false rejects
